name: Allow s3:GetObject on * fenced by a Deny with NotResource to one approved bucket (not broad exfil)
note: A data-perimeter guardrail: read is allowed broadly, but an explicit Deny with NotResource excludes everything except the approved bucket, confining the effective read to that one bucket.
rationale: NotResource in a Deny statement applies the Deny to every resource EXCEPT those listed. Here s3:GetObject is denied on all resources except arn:aws:s3:::approved-data/*, so the broad Allow is fenced down to a single bucket. Because explicit Deny wins and the Deny covers everything outside approved-data/*, there is no broad object-read (DATA-EXFIL) capability - the effective reach is one approved bucket. Flagging broad exfil here would overstate the risk. Ref: AWS docs, 'IAM JSON policy elements: NotResource' + explicit-Deny precedence.
